title: Tool Execution & Sandboxing
summary: This module provides core primitives for integrating and executing external tools within a sandboxed environment, enabling LLMs to interact with dynamic data and functions. It handles variable representation, code generation for tool wrappers, and cross-runtime tool call bridging.

nodes.label: Represent REPL Variable Metadata
nodes.title: REPLVariable
nodes.description: Defines a data structure to hold metadata (name, type, description, preview) for variables within a Read-Eval-Print Loop (REPL) environment, facilitating their display and use by LLMs.

nodes.label: Define Sandbox Object Interface
nodes.title: SandboxSerializable
nodes.description: An abstract base class that specifies how Python objects should be serialized, injected, and reconstructed within a sandboxed execution environment for LLM interaction.

nodes.label: Generate Python Tool Wrapper
nodes.title: makeToolWrapper
nodes.description: A JavaScript function that dynamically creates Python code for a tool wrapper. This wrapper allows Python code to invoke JavaScript-based tool execution.

nodes.label: Orchestrate Tool Execution (JS)
nodes.title: toolCallBridge
nodes.description: A JavaScript function that handles the actual execution of tools by communicating with an external host, sending tool call requests, and processing responses, including error handling.

nodes.label: Python Execution Environment
nodes.title: Python Environment
nodes.description: The Python runtime where generated tool wrappers and SandboxSerializable objects are utilized for LLM-driven code execution.

nodes.label: JavaScript Runtime
nodes.title: JavaScript Runtime
nodes.description: The JavaScript environment where tool wrapper generation and tool call bridging logic are executed.

nodes.label: External Tool Provider
nodes.title: External Tool Provider
nodes.description: Represents the external system or service responsible for executing the actual tool logic requested by the tool call bridge.

groups.label: Data & Variable Representation
groups.title: Data & Variable Representation
groups.description: Components for defining how variables and complex objects are represented and serialized for use within sandboxed or interactive LLM environments.

groups.label: Tool Integration & Execution
groups.title: Tool Integration & Execution
groups.description: Mechanisms for generating Python wrappers for tools and bridging their execution between different runtime environments (e.g., Python and JavaScript) and external services.
